property_summary: Reference always transfers the entire balance to the caller when block.number % 15 == 0, resulting in zero contract balance at the end of that fallback; mutant never transfers, so its balance is always > 0 after any successful fallback. After an internal precondition that guarantees a transfer would occur, the reference balance must be zero while the mutant's is not.
change_summary: Delete the entire if block that conditionally transfers the contract balance.
